title: The effects of saffron supplementation on cardiovascular risk factors in adults: A systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis.

answer.design_quote: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that evaluated the effects of saffron on lipid profiles, glycemic control, blood pressure, anthropometric measures, and inflammatory markers were included.
answer.k_quote: In the meta-analysis, 32 studies were taken into account ( n = 1674).
